title: Consanguineous recessive family
goal: A reader can trace the shared ancestry of two carrier parents and identify their affected proband, a deceased relative, and a pregnancy loss.

rubric.must: All individual symbol centers within each generation share a horizontal level, and the four rows have legible Roman-numeral labels I through IV.
The union between III-1 and III-2 consists of two visibly separate parallel lines, while all other unions use single lines.
The parent-child lines visibly show that III-1 and III-2 descend through two different children of the same generation-I couple.
Both parents in the double-line union have half-filled carrier symbols and are visibly connected to a fully filled affected child and an empty unaffected child.
Exactly one family member has a proband arrow labeled P, and its tip clearly identifies the fully filled female IV-1 without touching a sibling or descent line.
I-1 has a single diagonal deceased slash through his square, with the half-filled carrier status still distinguishable.
IV-3 appears as a small pregnancy-loss triangle connected as a sibling of IV-1 and IV-2, with its label legible and separate from the proband marker.

ideal.notes: Deceased half-filled carrier I-1 heads two branches whose first cousins III-1 and III-2 marry on a double consanguinity line, producing affected proband IV-1, unaffected IV-2, and an open spontaneous-abortion triangle IV-3.
